gauge_label: Elizabeth River at the Midtown Tunnel (in MLLW)
detail: A chance of showers and thunderstorms between 11pm and 2am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly cloudy, with a low around 67. Southeast wind 2 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.
surge_basis: worst-credible storm tide 8.02 ft MLLW (Chesapeake-Potomac hurricane, 23 Aug 1933; gauge major-flood category 7 ft), converted to metres
